useCases.title: Draft a booking request
postconditions: BookingRequest exists with Status = Draft, invisible to officers
mainFlow: 1. Agent saves a booking request as Draft and completes it later; drafts are invisible to officers.

useCases.title: Submit a booking request
preconditions: Vessel, berth, ETA, ETD and cargo class are filled
ETD is later than ETA and the stay is 30 days or less
Submission is between 48 hours and 90 days before ETA
postconditions: A unique reference in format HB-YYYY-NNNNN is assigned and never reused, even if the request is later cancelled
mainFlow: 1. Agent completes the mandatory fields: vessel, berth, ETA, ETD, cargo class.
2. System validates ETD > ETA, stay <= 30 days, IMO number format, submission timing window.
3. On submission the system assigns a unique booking reference in the format HB-YYYY-NNNNN.

useCases.title: Edit a submitted request before review
preconditions: No officer has opened it for review yet
mainFlow: 1. Agent may edit a Submitted request until an officer opens it for review, after which it is locked.

useCases.title: Cancel a booking request
postconditions: Reference is retained for the audit trail, never reused
A late-cancellation fee of 50% of the berth fee applies if within 72 hours of ETA
mainFlow: 1. Agent cancels an Approved or earlier-stage booking; a Completed booking cannot be cancelled.
2. Cancellation is free of charge until 24 hours before ETA.
3. Cancellations made within 72 hours of ETA are charged 50% of the berth fee.

useCases.title: AIS feed marks a booking Arrived
preconditions: AIS feed reports the vessel inside the port geofence
mainFlow: 1. System imports vessel positions from the AIS feed every 5 minutes and flags a booking as Arrived when the vessel enters the port geofence.

attributes.name: IsArrived
attributes.note: set by the AIS integration, UC005

microflows.name: ACT_BookingRequest_Submit
microflows.purpose: Validates mandatory fields and timing, assigns a permanent reference, sets Status = Submitted.
validations: Vessel, berth, ETA, ETD and cargo class are required.
ETD must be later than ETA.
Stay longer than 30 days is rejected.
IMO number must be exactly 7 digits.
Cannot submit more than 90 days before ETA.
Must submit at least 48 hours before ETA.

microflows.name: ACT_BookingRequest_Cancel
microflows.purpose: Cancels a booking, computing the late-cancellation fee where applicable.
validations: Free of charge until 24 hours before ETA.
Within 72 hours of ETA: 50% of the berth fee charged.

microflows.name: SUB_AIS_ImportPositions
microflows.purpose: Scheduled every 5 minutes: imports AIS vessel positions and flags matching bookings Arrived on geofence entry.
